notes.implementation: Active player declares before active attack effects. The defender declares after active effects and before nonactive effects. Store each declared hand UID and zone serial, recheck shields and dark/fire mana for each Oni-end resolution; no later-acquired cards. Existing Ninja declarations share the defender window.

One actual reverse cast per attack. Each cast creates its own delayed dark3 obligation. Resolve after untap at next own start with no summon/cast reduction. Mandatory payment if payable, otherwise defeat. Genmu suppresses the low-cost spells delayed effect. A copy cast by Cyclepedia creates no second reverse obligation.

Per battlefield UID/incarnation and turn optional reuse of the same face of the same physical spell, only if still in grave since original hand cast. Grave-cast replacement goes to bottom after resolution. Charger self-movement takes priority. Declining preserves the once-per-turn use.

Only from hand, only opponents turn with dark and fire mana. Reveal and bottom the actual hand card; may restore an empty deck. Do not apply another replacement to a replacement victory. Continuous alternate-victory conditions are checked again by the existing engine.

Katsuking checks Revolution2 after simultaneous shield removal, Revolution0 continuous power/speed/breaker, choose one of top5 then order remainder then optional bounce. Buster selects all non-evolution multicolour creatures under shared total6 before any enters; shares Final Revolution cap with existing cards. Applies speed to itself too.

sourceAccess.canonicalMetadata: All eight complete official face records already in dist/details.json (2026-10-20). Original sources were retained, no unverified refresh dates assigned.
sourceAccess.verifiedSearch: Official current card results corroborated all eight names and ability text. Direct Cyclepedia, Buster, Jaouga and Fortune fetches intermittently returned maintenance/503; search-cache results and existing official snapshot used.
sourceAccess.newPrint: Katsuking and Buster current 25-deck reprints found in official search; equivalent mechanics retained with original IDs.

ai: Decline optional Baba deployment when an opposing Kaku return would loop it back. Katsuking optional bounce favours opponents and permits own targets as a player choice.
